_README: Editable file with monthly Highlights & Lowlights for DAE dashboard.
Edit this file when a new month closes. Save it in the same folder as make_executive_summary.py.
When you run `python make_executive_summary.py`, it reads this file and updates the dashboard.
pnl_notes:  optional extra notes per P&L line (Revenue commentary is auto-generated from Excel data).
HTML allowed in body for formatting:
Months use format Mmm-YY (e.g., May-26, Jun-26). To add a new month, copy any existing block and change the key.
P&L Commentary is AUTO-GENERATED from your Excel using this framework:
Revenue: closed at $X (X% MoM; X% vs Bud) driven by Revenue per Hour, Supply Hours, Trips/Hour, Price/Trip, Active Drivers, Hires/Churn
Gross Profit: from Revenue + OPEX drivers (Driver Payments, Maintenance, Marketing, Uber Take Rate, etc.)
EBITDA: from GP + SG&A drivers (Direct Business Line, Cross Func + Corp G&A, Payroll)
Net Income: from EBITDA + D&A + Interest + Taxes
You only fill highlights/lowlights. P&L commentary updates automatically when Excel data changes.

_TEMPLATE_NEW_MONTH._comment: Copy this block, rename key to e.g. 'May-26', fill in highlights & lowlights.

highlights.title: Revenue Performance
highlights.body: Closed at MXN $52.9m (-20.3% MoM; +6.9% vs Budget), driven by: Revenue per Hour -20.9% MoM ($207 vs $261.6) but +12.5% vs Budget ($207 vs $184) thanks to higher trips per hour (1.46 vs 1.40 Bud) and higher price per trip ($142.0 vs $131.3 Bud).

highlights.title: Uber Co-Branding
highlights.body: Received 3rd co-branding payment from Uber totaling MXN $144k for January after achieving 100% of the 120 EVs target. Scaling to 240 co-branded EVs (100% of Feb target).

highlights.title: World Cup Prep
highlights.body: Active preparation for 2026 World Cup: (i) Vehicle Image Refurbishment + traceability; (ii) WC theme activation (hub branding + driver apparel); (iii) maximizing fleet availability through targeted OOS reduction; (iv) exploring Uber-VEMO joint demand-concentration strategies.

lowlights.title: Performance Ratio
lowlights.body: +174 bps MoM (73.0% vs 71.3%) but -428 bps below Budget (73.0% vs 77.2%). Supply hours +2.5% MoM (251,074 hrs vs 245,067) but -4.9% vs Budget.

lowlights.title: Hiring
lowlights.body: 603 hires (+27.5% MoM) driven by (i) Maria DAE recruiting AI agent (+30% higher conversion vs fully human process); (ii) lead generation provider delivered 9,107 leads (+55% MoM, +24% vs 2025 historical).

pnl_revenue.bud: (MXN +$3.4m): Mainly driven by the recognition of 3 days of December in January due to year end-accounting close (ca. +2.0m).
pnl_revenue.mom: (MXN -$13.5m): Mainly driven by (i) the release of a 2025 Uber provision recognized in the prior month (+$10.6m); additionally; and (ii) lower advertising revenues by Ola Media (-$1.4m).

pnl_gp.bud: (MXN -$0.7m): Driven by (i) higher Revenues (+$3.4m), offset by a (ii) higher payroll costs (-$2.7m) due to headcount growth (+62 drivers in January) and the payment of three additional days of wages and benefits corresponding to December, (iii) higher maintenance (-$0.7m), (iv) higher Uber Take Rate (-$0.5m) and (v) higher Towing service (-$0.2m).
pnl_gp.mom: (MXN -$24.8m): Driven by: (i) lower Revenues (-$13.5), (ii) higher labor costs from the minimum wage increase (+13%), therefore higher Driver payments (-$7.5m), (iii) the refund of the Uber Take Rate related to Q4 (-$3.3m), and (iv) higher maintenance due to increased incidents (-$0.5m).

pnl_ebitda.bud: (MXN -$0.4m): Driven by: (i) lower GP (-$0.7m). This was affected by (ii) a higher Direct SG&A (-$0.5m), due to an increase related to union expenses (-$0.3m) and higher payroll expense (-$0.2m), and this was offset by (iii) lower CF and Corporate (+$0.8m).
pnl_ebitda.mom: (MXN -22.3m): Driven by (i) lower GP (-$24.8m). This was offset by (ii) lower CF and Corp (+$1.5m) and (iii) lower Direct SG&A (+$1.0m).

pnl_ni.bud: (MXN +$0.7m): Driven by (i) lower EBITDA (-$0.4m), (ii) higher D&A (-$0.3m) and (iii) lower Interest Expense (+$0.3m) and (iv) lower Taxes (+$1.2m) due to no tax provision this period.
pnl_ni.mom: (MXN -22.3m): Driven by (i) lower EBITDA (-$22.3m), (ii) higher D&A (+$0.1m) and (iii) lower Interest Expense (-$0.1) and (iv) Taxes in line.

highlights.title: Revenue Performance
highlights.body: Closed at MXN $52.5m (-0.8% MoM; +9.7% vs Budget). Revenue per Hour +4.6% MoM ($216.6 vs $207) and +10.2% vs Budget. Higher trips per hour 1.46 (vs 1.41 Bud) + higher price per trip $147.9 (vs $139.8 Bud), partly from 6 days of air quality government restrictions.

highlights.title: Hiring strong
highlights.body: 583 hires this month, continuing strong recruitment momentum.

highlights.title: Performance Ratio
highlights.body: Increased +405 bps MoM (77.1% vs 73.0%), only -38 bps below Budget (77.1% vs 77.5%).

lowlights.title: Churn QHSE Matrix
lowlights.body: Overall churn increased from 29.5% to 34.9% (excl. DAE-LTO transitions). +40% churn driven by stricter QHSE Matrix (deliberate decision for safety standards, accident reduction, fleet condition).

lowlights.title: Supply Hours
lowlights.body: Decreased -4.7% MoM (239,344 vs 251,074) but +0.2% above Budget.

pnl_revenue.bud: (MXN +$4.6m): Mainly driven by higher revenue per hour ($216.6 vs. $196.6); Despite having slightly higher SH 0.2%, price per ride was higher ($147.9 vs $139.8), mainly due to six days of environmental contingency.
pnl_revenue.mom: (MXN -$0.4m): Mainly by (i) lower ride hailing revenues Inc. Uber Bonus (-$0.3m), due to 3 additional days in Jan, reflected in lower SH this month (239k vs. 251k); (ii) slightly lower advertising revenues (-$0.1m).

pnl_gp.bud: (MXN +$2.3m): Driven by higher revenues (+$4.6m), partially offset by: (i) higher payroll cost (-$1.8m) due to HC growth (+113 drivers in Feb), (ii) higher Uber take rate (-$0.4m) and higher washing costs (-$0.1m). Despite increase in OPEX GPm better than Budget (21.8% vs. 19.2%).
pnl_gp.mom: (MXN +$4.6m): Driven by lower OPEX (+$5.0m), mainly from (i) lower payroll cost (+$3.3m), due to three additional paid days in Jan, (ii) lower maintenance (+$0.9m), due to the interco adjustments in maintenance rates; (iii) lower towing services (+$0.3m), (iv) and lower marketing expenses (ca. +$0.3m). Partially offset by lower Revenues (-$0.4m).

pnl_ebitda.mom: (MXN +$4.3m): Driven by: (i) higher GP (+$4.6m), and (ii) lower DL G&A (+$0.1m), mainly due to a lower union costs (+ca. 0.2m), offset by higher CF & Corp. SG&A (-$0.6m).

pnl_ni.bud: (MXN +$3.1m): Driven by (i) higher EBITDA (+$2.3m), (ii) lower taxes (+$1.2m); and (iii) lower interest expense (+$0.2m), due to higher interest income from cash accounts; partially offset by higher D&A (-$0.5m), due to a higher depreciation from vehicle upgrades and additional fleet (+5 vehicles).
pnl_ni.mom: (MXN +$4.2m): Driven by higher EBITDA (+$4.3m). Partially offset by slightly higher D&A (ca. -$0.1m).

highlights.title: Revenue Performance
highlights.body: Closed at MXN $53.4m (+1.7% MoM; +4.5% vs Budget). YTD revenue +7.0% vs Budget.

highlights.title: Gross Profit YoY
highlights.body: +214.7% YoY ($13.2m vs $4.2m Mar-25) and +14.9% MoM vs Feb-26 ($11.5m). YTD GP +44.9% vs Budget.

highlights.title: EBITDA YoY
highlights.body: EBITDA $4.3m, +164.8% YoY vs ($6.7m) Mar-25. EBITDA margin 8.1% vs (negative) prior year.

lowlights.title: Hiring
lowlights.body: Closed -19.2% MoM in hires (471 vs 583) despite record lead volume 10,408 (+45.8% MoM, highest in trailing 6 months). Lead Quality: only 22.6% of leads reached induction (vs 29.7% Feb, 35.0% Jan). Driving Test Filter: 432/1,077 candidates failed (40.1%) vs 18.9% in Feb. ~130 fewer hires.

lowlights.title: Revenue per Hour
lowlights.body: -8.8% MoM ($197.4 vs $216.6) but +3.3% vs Budget.

pnl_revenue.bud: (MXN +$2.3m): Mainly driven by higher revenue per hour ($197.4 vs. $191.2), on account of (i) 1.7% higher SH (267K vs. 262K); and (ii) higher price per ride ($142.0 vs. $136.1).
pnl_revenue.mom: (MXN +$0.9m): Mainly driven by (i) higher SH this month (267K vs. 239k), partially offset by lower RPH ($142.0 vs. $147.9).

pnl_gp.bud: (MXN +$4.1m): (i) Higher revenues (+$2.3m) and (ii) lower OPEX, primarily from reduced driver payroll (+$1.8m), reflecting a lower average weekly salary ($4,127 vs. $4,517), following changes in driver classification criteria that reduced the number of drivers earning additional incentives.
pnl_gp.mom: (MXN +$1.7m): Higher revenues (+$0.9), and lower OPEX (+$0.8m), mainly from: (i) lower payroll cost (+$1.2m), driven by lower HC -84 (1,493 vs. 1,577). Partially offset by (ii) higher towing expenses (-$0.2m) and (iii) driving penalties (-$0.2m), primarily related to airport fines, which were agreed to be reimbursed by Uber.

pnl_ebitda.bud: (MXN +$4.6m): Driven by: (i) higher GP (+$4.1m) and lower Corporate Expenses (ca. +$0.5m).
pnl_ebitda.mom: (MXN +$2.0m): Driven by: (i) higher GP (+$1.7m), (ii) lower DL G&A (ca. +$0.2m), mainly due to a reduced payroll expense (+$0.4m) from Jan-Feb retroactive adjustments to employee social security partially offset by higher subscriptions costs (-$0.2m).

pnl_ni.bud: (MXN +$5.5m): Driven by (i) higher EBITDA (+$4.6m), (ii) lower taxes (+$1.3m); and (iii) lower interest expense (+$0.2m), due to higher interest income from cash accounts; partially offset by higher D&A (-$0.5m), due to higher depreciation from vehicle upgrades.

highlights.title: Revenue YTD
highlights.body: YTD revenue $210.2m +6.7% vs Budget ($197.1m). YoY +1.5% vs Apr-25 ($50.6m).

highlights.title: Lead Volume Record
highlights.body: Second consecutive record month — 11,063 leads (+6.3% MoM). Same-month hires +40% (leads generated and signed within April).

highlights.title: EBITDA YTD
highlights.body: EBITDA YTD +175.8% vs Budget ($2.3m vs Bud -$3.0m).

lowlights.title: Performance Ratio
lowlights.body: Decreased -420 bps MoM (73.4% vs 77.6%) and -437 bps vs Budget (73.4% vs 77.8%). Supply hours -8.3% MoM (244,831 vs 267,053).

lowlights.title: Hiring
lowlights.body: Closed -3.8% MoM in hires (453 vs 471). Lead Quality: -41% decrease in hires from prior-month leads. Driving Test Filter: fail rate 40.5% (vs historical 19%) → net loss 158 drivers in March + 211 in April.

lowlights.title: EBITDA Month
lowlights.body: EBITDA ($2.5m) in April vs Budget ($1.3m) — -95.5% vs Bud. Driven by higher OPEX +13.0% MoM.

lowlights.title: OPEX
lowlights.body: ($44.3m) -13.0% MoM and -9.5% vs Budget. Driven by Driver Payments scaling and Maintenance.

lowlights.title: Gross Profit Month
lowlights.body: $7.1m, -50.3% MoM ($14.2m → $7.1m) and -13.0% vs Budget.

pnl_revenue.bud: (MXN +$2.8m): Mainly driven by higher RPH ($204.3 vs. $188.6), on account of a higher price per ride +12.7% ($144.8 vs. $128.4), partially offset by -2.8% lower SH (244K vs. 251K).
pnl_revenue.mom: (MXN -$2.1m): Driven by lower SH (244k vs. 267K), on account of a lower PR (73.4% vs. 77.6%). Partially offset by higher RPH ($204.3 vs. $197.4).

pnl_gp.bud: (MXN -$1.1m): Driven by higher OPEX (-$3.9m), primarily due to: (a) higher driver payments (-$1.1m), driven by 2 additional payment days not accounted in March; (b) higher maintenance & towing expenses (-$1.4m), (i.e., vehicle campaign rebranding for the World Cup); (c) operating costs associated to higher revenues (-$1.4m) (e.g., Uber TR, washing, telematics).
pnl_gp.mom: (MXN -$7.2m): Mainly driven by (i) higher OPEX (-$5.1m), primarily due to: (a) higher driver payments (-$3.0m), driven by 4 additional payment days vs. prior month, (b) higher maintenance expense (-$0.4m), driven by increased corrective services (560 vs. 463); and (c) higher operating costs associated to higher revenues (-$1.9m) (e.g., Uber TR, telematics); and (ii) lower revenues (-$2.1m).

pnl_ebitda.bud: (MXN -$1.2m): Driven by: (i) lower GP (-$1.1m), (ii) higher DBL expenses (-$0.9m), driven by higher HC and in advance of delta incremental to sustain operations under the LTO leasing to DAE; partially offset by lower CF & Corp. G&A (ca. +$0.7m).
pnl_ebitda.mom: (MXN -$6.9m): Driven by: (i) lower GP (-$7.2m), partially offset by (ii) lower SG&A Expenses (+$0.3m), due to: (a) lower DL G&A (+$0.1m) explained by lower Legal expenses (+$0.1m); and (b) lower CF & Corp. G&A (+$0.1m).

pnl_ni.bud: (MXN -$0.3m): Driven by (i) lower EBITDA (-$1.2m), (ii) higher D&A (-$0.5m) from vehicle upgrades; partially offset by (iii) lower taxes (+$1.2m), and (iv) lower net interest expense (ca. +$0.3m).

highlights.title: Oro Category Drivers
highlights.body: Oro category closed at 48.3%, the highest share since implementing the new compensation system.

highlights.title: Churn
highlights.body: Total churn closed at 34.7% (-3.2 p.p. MoM), driven by a reduction in involuntary exits (-6 p.p. MoM).

highlights.title: Unit Impulse Program
highlights.body: In May we kicked off the Unit Impulse Program: semi-new LTO units were injected into DAE, with an increase of +60 shifts in San Pedro de los Pinos.

lowlights.title: Conversion Rate
lowlights.body: Despite a +30% increase in leads, the conversion rate dropped to 1.3% (-0.3 p.p. WoW).

lowlights.title: Level A Image
lowlights.body: Units with Level A Image closed at 35.9%. An audit with Ops was carried out to re-evaluate unit levels.

lowlights.title: Performance Ratio
lowlights.body: Performance Ratio closed at 70.9% (-2.5 p.p. MoM) — the worst reading since June last year.

lowlights.title: Airport Impound Yards
lowlights.body: Airport impound yards increased to 18, though partially mitigated by a -15% reduction in average days detained per yard.

lowlights.title: Safety Events
lowlights.body: The month recorded 171 safety events, concentrated in low-tenure drivers: 33% with less than 30 days, and 49% with less than 60 days.

pnl_revenue.bud: (MXN +$2.6m): Mainly driven by higher RPH +12.2% ($225.0 vs. $200.6), on account of a higher price per ride +9.4% ($153.7 vs. $140.5), partially offset by lower SH -6.6% (243K vs. 260K).
pnl_revenue.mom: (MXN +$4.8m): Mainly driven by higher RPH +10.1% ($225.0 vs. $204.3), on account of a higher price per ride +6.1% ($153.7 vs. $144.8), slightly offset by lower SH (243K vs. 244K).

pnl_gp.bud: (MXN +$1.1m): Driven by (i) higher Revenue (+$2.6m), partially offset by (ii) higher OPEX (-$1.5m), primarily due to: (a) higher maintenance expense (-$0.5m); (b) higher marketing expense (-$0.4m), driven by increased lead generation to support fleet expansion and driver recruitment; (c) higher washing costs (-$0.3m) due to an increase in total fleet (650 vs. 619); and (d) higher Uber TR (-$0.3m) associated with higher revenues.
pnl_gp.mom: (MXN +$5.5m): Mainly driven by (i) higher revenue (+$4.8m), (ii) lower OPEX (+$0.7m), primarily due to: (a) lower driver payments (+$0.5m), on account of a lower driver HC (1,390 vs. 1,418), (b) lower maintenance expense (+$0.2m), driven by a lower number of services performed (731 vs. 910).

pnl_ebitda.bud: (MXN -$2.5m): Driven by (i) higher GP (+$1.1m); partially offset by (ii) higher DBL expenses (-$1.7m), driven by increased HC (154 vs. 80) to support operations associated with a larger total fleet (650 vs. 600); (iii) lower CF & Corp. G&A (-$1.9m).
pnl_ebitda.mom: (MXN +$2.0m): Driven by (i) higher GP (+$5.5m), partially offset by (ii) higher DBL expenses (-$0.9m) explained by (a) higher payroll expenses (-$0.6m) due to a higher HC (154 vs. 144), (b) higher insurance and cleaning expenses (-$0.3m) driven by payment phasing; and (iii) higher CF & Corp. G&A (-$2.7m).

pnl_ni.bud: (MXN -$1.5m): Driven by (i) lower EBITDA (-$2.5m), (ii) higher D&A (-$0.5m) from vehicle upgrades; partially offset by (iii) lower taxes (+$1.3m), and (iv) lower net interest expense (ca. +$0.3m).
